# Shared types

User-defined types and naming functions that every module and solution imports, so one object has one shape and one resource has one name pattern across the repo.

<!-- Generated by scripts/update-readme.sh from the compiled template. Edit the @description and @metadata decorators instead. -->

| | |
|---|---|
| Version | `1.0.0` |
| Use it | `import { … } from 'br/platform:types:v1.0.0'` |

## Types

### contextType

Where a resource is deployed. Every module takes it as pContext.

| Property | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| environment | yes | [environmentType](#environmenttype) | Environment short name, used in every resource name. |
| location | yes | [regionType](#regiontype) | Azure region of the resources. |
| tags | no | object | Tags added to every resource. Example: `{"workload":"sample-app","owner":"platform-team"}` |

### domainServicesType

A Microsoft Entra Domain Services managed domain. A tenant can have only one.

| Property | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| domainName | yes | string | DNS name of the managed domain. Use a domain you own. Example: `aaddscontoso.com` |
| sku | yes | string | Size of the managed domain. Allowed values: `Enterprise`, `Premium`, `Standard` |
| notifyEmails | no | string[] | Email addresses notified about alerts on the managed domain, on top of the domain admins. Example: `["platform-team@contoso.com"]` |

### environmentType

Environment short name. Each environment has its own management group hierarchy and subscriptions.

- Type: string
- Allowed values: `dev`, `prod`

### hubVnetType

The hub virtual network a spoke peers with. The platform stack owns it; a spoke only references it.

| Property | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| subscriptionId | yes | string | Subscription of the hub. |
| resourceGroupName | yes | string | Resource group of the hub. Example: `rg-hub-prod-szn-001` |
| name | yes | string | Name of the hub virtual network. Example: `vnet-hub-prod-szn-001` |

### managementGroupKeyType

Management groups of the hierarchy, named relative to its root.

- Type: string
- Allowed values: `decommissioned`, `landingzones-corp`, `landingzones-online`, `platform-connectivity`, `platform-identity`, `platform-management`, `platform-security`, `sandbox`

### platformSubscriptionsType

The four platform subscriptions of an environment.

| Property | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| connectivity | yes | string | Hub network and private DNS. |
| identity | yes | string | Microsoft Entra Domain Services. |
| management | yes | string | Log Analytics for the platform. |
| security | yes | string | Microsoft Sentinel. |

### regionType

Azure regions this platform deploys to. Each one has a short code in regionCode().

- Type: string
- Allowed values: `switzerlandnorth`, `switzerlandwest`, `westeurope`

### securityRuleType

One rule of a network security group.

| Property | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| name | yes | string | Rule name. Example: `allow-https-from-vnet` |
| priority | yes | int | Priority between 100 and 4096. Lower runs first. Minimum value: 100. Maximum value: 4096 |
| direction | yes | string | Traffic direction. Allowed values: `Inbound`, `Outbound` |
| access | yes | string | Allow or deny the traffic. Allowed values: `Allow`, `Deny` |
| protocol | yes | string | Network protocol. Allowed values: `*`, `Tcp`, `Udp` |
| sourceAddressPrefix | yes | string | Source address prefix or service tag. Example: `VirtualNetwork` |
| destinationPortRange | yes | string | Destination port or range. Example: `443` |

### storageSkuType

Storage account redundancy.

- Type: string
- Allowed values: `Standard_GZRS`, `Standard_LRS`, `Standard_ZRS`

### subscriptionPlacementType

A subscription and the management group it belongs in.

| Property | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| group | yes | [managementGroupKeyType](#managementgroupkeytype) | Management group, relative to the root of the hierarchy. Example: `landingzones-corp` |
| subscriptionId | yes | string | Subscription to place there. |

## Functions

| Function | Returns | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `regionCode(location regionType)` | string | Short code of an Azure region, used in resource names. |
| `resourceName(abbreviation string, name string, context contextType, instance int)` | string | Resource name in the pattern <abbreviation>-<name>-<environment>-<region code>-<instance>. |
